title: Clear the Windows Update cache
description: Stop the Windows Update services and clean the SoftwareDistribution folder to fix update problems

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Stop-Service
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: Stop-Service -Name wuauserv,bits -Force; Remove-Item -Path C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name wuauserv,bits

examples.description: Clean the Windows Update download cache completely

examples.command: Stop-Service -Name wuauserv,bits -Force; Remove-Item -Path C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name wuauserv,bits -Confirm:$false
examples.description: Run the action without an interactive confirmation. -Confirm:$false suppresses the prompts. Useful in automated scripts, but use it with care: there is no safety net.

examples.command: Stop-Service -Name wuauserv,bits -Force; Remove-Item -Path C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name wuauserv,bits -Verbose
examples.description: Show detailed information about the command's execution. -Verbose enables debug messages to understand exactly what happens. Essential for troubleshooting and for understanding the internal operations.

examples.command: Stop-Service -Name wuauserv,bits -Force; Remove-Item -Path C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name wuauserv,bits
examples.description: Stop the Windows Update services and clean the SoftwareDistribution folder to fix update problems.

notes: WARNING: requires administrator rights. Stops the Windows Update services temporarily. Use it when updates fail to download.

fr.title: Nettoyer le cache Windows Update
fr.description: Arrête les services Windows Update et nettoie le dossier SoftwareDistribution pour résoudre les problèmes de mises à jour
fr.notes: ATTENTION: Nécessite des droits administrateur. Arrête temporairement les services Windows Update. À utiliser en cas de problèmes de téléchargement de mises à jour.
